hero.title:
Wwise Unreal
Engine Fixer
hero.subtitle: After every Perforce pull, Wwise broke. Asset paths disappeared. I built a tool that fixes it automatically. One click, everything restored.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.p1: Every Perforce pull broke Wwise. Asset paths disappeared. Actors went silent. We'd lose 20 minutes fixing it manually.
problem.p2: I got tired of fixing it by hand, so I wrote a tool. One click, everything fixed.

phase1.title: Detects Issues
phase1.desc: Scans project files. Finds broken Wwise references.

phase2.title: Fixes Everything
phase2.desc: Restores plugin settings. Updates configs. Rebuilds references. All automatic.

phase3.title: Creates Backup
phase3.desc: Backs up your project first. Safe to use.

f1.title: Scans Project
f1.desc: Finds broken Wwise references in .uasset and config files.

f2.title: Fixes References
f2.desc: Restores plugin paths. Updates configs. Rebuilds asset links. One click.

f3.title: Backup First
f3.desc: Creates a timestamped backup before making changes. Safe to run.

f4.title: Logs Everything
f4.desc: Every file change is logged. Easy to see what happened.

f5.title: Targeted Fixes
f5.desc: Only touches Wwise-related files. Leaves everything else alone.

f6.title: Works on Teams
f6.desc: Tested on Shadow Frames (multi-person project with Perforce). The whole team uses it now.

tech.title: How I Built It
tech.subtitle: Started with batch scripting and Windows APIs. Used AI assistance for the Python GUI and error handling.

cta.title: Stop Fixing Wwise Manually
cta.subtitle: Download from GitHub. Run it. Done.
